questions.question: You are preparing to leave your suburban home on foot during a winter storm. Which water treatment method is most effective at killing all microbes (bacteria, viruses, parasites) if you must use natural sources?
options: Boiling water for 1 minute (3 minutes at high altitude)
Using a standard 1-micron filter
Adding iodine tablets only
Using a UV pen only
questions.explanation: Boiling is the best way to kill microbes. Filters may not remove viruses, and iodine/UV have limitations. Boil clear water for 1 minute (3 minutes above 6,500 ft). [citation:5]

questions.question: You find a clear mountain stream. Is it safe to drink directly from it without treatment?
options: Yes, clear water is always safe.
No, even clear water can contain microbes that cause illness.
Yes, if it is flowing fast.
Only if you are in a suburban area.
questions.explanation: Water that looks clear can still contain harmful bacteria, viruses, and parasites. Always treat it. [citation:5]
